description: Full-text search of all pages of the website, in English or Chinese; the language follows the query unless lang is given. Returns the most relevant pages and sections (ten by default), each with an identifier for fetch, a title, the page address and an excerpt. Use it to locate information before citing it.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

query.description: Search terms, in English or Chinese

name: search

source_url.description: Address of the page on which the data is published

title: Search the website
